And furthermore, I compiled supplementary tables of my own, touching the probable quantity

In the first place, the amount of butter and texel and laden cheese consumed seems amazing.
I impute it, though, to their naturally unctuous natures, being rendered still more unctuous
by the nature of their vocation, and especially by their pursuing their game in those frigid
polar seas, on the very coasts of that Esquimox country where the convivial natives pledge
each other in bumpers of train oil.
